about_the_game:
🥚 SILIVRI – CAPITAL OF CHAOS

Welcome to the city of Silivri.
A place where logic ends and comedy struggles to survive.

🤝 CO-OP CHAOS

Play with 1–3 players in an online co-op system within the same city.
Team up to complete missions, jump into the same car, interact with different NPCs,
or betray your friend at the most critical moment.

Cooperation... or the first step toward betrayal — the choice is yours.

🧩 MISSIONS

In Silivri, every corner hides a mission — and every mission is pure nonsense:

  • DiplomAli & Document Kenan → Track down fake diploma dealers.

  • Tent Tuncay → Craft and sell tents for protesters in the Park of March.

  • Helpful Hayri → Deliver aid packages to a ship bound for Gaza.

  • Budget Bekir → (Hint: Nobody knows.)

  • Six-Seat Council → Take missions from this untrustworthy group — and do the opposite of what they say.

Each mission reveals another layer of the city’s absurd order.

🏙️ OPEN WORLD: SILIVRI

Skyscrapers, slums, POKI apartments, the coastal road, the Park of March,
and far away — the infamous VIP Prison.

A living world where cars fill the streets, NPCs randomly brawl,
and logic is completely useless.

A full day–night cycle, random events, and countless “what the hell” moments await you.

💰 ECONOMY & DIRTY MONEY

Money doesn’t come easy:

Hunt down shady figures like Maparacı, 100xGrandpa, and Mail Order.
Launder your dirty money at the Beauty & Tax Evasion Salon.
Then buy food at the market, vehicles at the dealership, or frying pans from the illegal arms dealer.

Economic crisis? Here, it’s just another punchline.

🚗 VEHICLES & FUEL SYSTEM

Without fuel, you won’t last long in Silivri.
Even refueling becomes part of the city’s ridiculous seriousness.

🚀 MAIN QUEST: DELIVER THE LAUNDRY!

Complete all major missions to unlock the gates of Silivri.
Deliver the clean laundry to the inmates inside…
If the city doesn’t drive you insane first.

⚙️ FEATURES

🔹 Online Co-op — Work with your friends or fuel the chaos together.
🔹 Open World City — A living Silivri filled with unpredictable NPCs.
🔹 Absurd Mission Chains — From bureaucracy to comedy.
🔹 Vehicle, Fuel, Economy, and Crafting Systems.
🔹 Funny Items, Troll Moments, Endless Laughter.
🔹 A Humor-Filled Sandbox — Write your own ridiculous story.

short_description: Silivri City — an open-world co-op game blending absurdity and dark humor! Complete missions, launder money, jump in your car, explore the city, or betray your friend. Every corner is nonsense, every NPC has a story. Your only goal: deliver the laundry... and don’t lose your mind!
